posts.caption:
Most awaited Friendship Edition is here ❤️✨

Over the last 20 editions, we’ve seen complete strangers walk into Paatashala… and walk out with people they still meet, travel with, and call their closest friends.

That’s the magic we’re celebrating this Friendship Day.

But don’t think we’re only singing friendship songs. 😌

We’ve curated a playlist packed with soulful melodies, nostalgic classics, feel-good hits, and full-on mass songs that you’ll scream your heart out to.

Whether you’re coming with your best friend, your gang, your partner, or all by yourself—this edition is for you.

And if this is your first Paatashala, there’s no better day to experience it.

❤️ Come for the music.
🤝 Stay for the people.
✨ Leave with memories you’ll carry long after the last song.

See you at our special #WeMetAtPaatashala Friendship Day Edition.

🎟️ Book your tickets now before they’re gone.
